_comment: The episode catalogue. One source of truth, read by both the Hub section and the weekly email job, so a title or link is never written down twice. Hand-maintained: add an entry when an episode publishes. `videoUrl` is the SharePoint item URL and stays empty until the file is uploaded -- the email job refuses to send an episode whose videoUrl is empty rather than mailing a dead link.

Working files may still live there; the copies people watch live here.

episodes.title: Stop copy-pasting your vendor list
episodes.summary: Three Excel functions replace the copy-paste-dedupe-sort routine on any export. =UNIQUE(range) returns the distinct values in a column, =SORT(UNIQUE(range)) makes it alphabetical, and =FILTER(table, column = criteria) returns every row matching a condition -- where the condition can point at a cell, so changing that one cell redraws the whole report.

episodes.title: Data Validation, the basic way and the way that maintains itself
episodes.summary: Every drop-down in Excel is the Data Validation feature. The basic way points Source at a range you selected, which goes stale silently when the data grows. Point it at an array formula's spill range instead -- Source: =$O$5# -- and the list maintains itself.
